entities.summary: The IRT New Lots Line or Livonia Avenue Line is a rapid transit line in the A Division of the New York City Subway. Located in the New York City borough of Brooklyn, the line runs from the Utica Avenue station in Crown Heights and continues to the New Lots Avenue station in East New York.
